# Evaluation results (generated by `python -m opsbridge.evaluate`)

Small SYNTHETIC sets (24 questions, 12 documents), also used during development: these numbers show regression safety, not generalisation.

| Metric | Value | Gate | Pass |
|---|---|---|---|
| hit_at_3 | 1.0 | >= 0.85 | PASS |
| citation_precision | 1.0 | >= 0.85 | PASS |
| abstention_accuracy | 1.0 | >= 0.80 | PASS |
| false_abstain_rate | 0.0 | <= 0.15 | PASS |
| classification_accuracy | 1.0 | >= 0.85 | PASS |
| route_accuracy | 1.0 | >= 0.90 | PASS |
| field_accuracy | 1.0 | >= 0.85 | PASS |
| unsafe_executions | 0 | == 0 | PASS |

Also: hit@1 1.0; latency p50 0.96 ms, p95 2.25 ms (local, in-process, no network).

Thresholds used: abstain below idf-coverage 0.3; auto-route at extraction confidence >= 0.75.

## Failure cases

- none

## What this does not show

- Real-world accuracy, other languages, long or scanned documents, or LLM quality (no LLM is used here).
- Ragas / LLM-judge metrics: not run (Ragas is not installed and needs an LLM judge).
